ShaderNodePreset.Description: Film DIR-coupler emulation - the inhibitor chemistry that makes film colour work, which curve/LUT film emulations skip. Inter-Layer effects give cross-channel colour separation and saturation; Adjacency effects give edge acutance and local contrast from inhibitor diffusion. Neutrals untouched; identity at zero.
ShaderNodePreset.Name: BB_FilmCoupler

Uniform.Tooltip: Input color space - sets the gamma decode for the coupler math
Uniform.Name: colorSpace

Uniform.Tooltip: Inter-layer effect: cross-channel coupling that increases colour separation and saturation the way film does
Uniform.Name: coupling

Uniform.Tooltip: Blend the coupled result with the original
Uniform.Name: mixAmount

Uniform.Tooltip: Adjacency effect: edge acutance / local contrast from inhibitor diffusion
Uniform.Name: acutance

Uniform.Tooltip: Inhibitor diffusion radius in pixels (edge effect scale)
Uniform.Name: radius
